description: Apply basic formatting conventions to AMPscript, SSJS, or Marketing Cloud Next (MCN) Handlebars code. Normalises keyword casing and whitespace. For Handlebars, collapses whitespace inside {{…}} mustaches while leaving {!$…} bindings and {{!-- … --}} comments untouched. (Handlebars formatting is a conservative whitespace normalizer; full Prettier Glimmer routing is deferred until prettier-plugin-sfmc ships Handlebars support.)
name: format_sfmc_code
